priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect and use Mirror Image pre-combat.
Pre-cast Frostfire Bolt and Meteor before entering combat.
Activate Combustion while a Fireball, Pyroblast, or Meteor is currently being cast or is mid-flight.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) when Combustion has more than 6 seconds remaining.
Spend Hot Streak procs on Flamestrike if there are 4 or more enemies and you have the Fuel the Fire talent.
Spend Hot Streak procs on Pyroblast if there are fewer than 4 enemies.
Cast Meteor during Combustion if the buff has more than 2 seconds remaining.
Spend Pyroclasm procs on Flamestrike (AoE) or Pyroblast (ST) only if Combustion is active with enough time remaining or is more than 12 seconds away.
Cast Scorch if Heat Shimmer is active or if the target is below 30% health to benefit from Scald.
Use Fire Blast off-the-GCD while casting another spell to convert Heating Up into a Hot Streak.
During Combustion, ensure Fire Blast is used to immediately convert every Heating Up into a Hot Streak to maximize instant casts.
Use Fireball as your primary filler spell to generate Heating Up procs when no instant casts are available.
If Hyperthermia is active, spam your Hot Streak spender (Flamestrike for AoE, Pyroblast for ST) for the duration of the buff.
Prioritize Fire Blast usage when the target is below 30% health and Combustion is on cooldown.
Avoid hard-casting Flamestrike or Pyroblast unless you have a Pyroclasm proc or are in the pre-combat opener.
